name: csi-sap2000
description: Lets Claude drive SAP2000 through the CSI API: build and edit models, run analyses and design, read database tables and results. Unofficial, not affiliated with Computers and Structures, Inc.
long_description: Connects Claude to a local SAP2000 installation through its COM API. Claude can attach to the running SAP2000 window or start a new instance, build or edit the model, run the analysis and design, and read any database table or Results function. Supports concrete, steel, cold-formed and aluminum design runs. A generic call_api tool reaches every function of the API, and search_api/api_doc read the API help file of your own installation. Requires Windows and a licensed SAP2000. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Computers and Structures, Inc.
